detailed_sections.heading: Design & Fit: What the Caliper Says
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the Salomon Men's X Ultra 5 Winter GTX Hiking Boot measures 1080g with a 11mm heel-to-toe drop. Winter-specific boot with 200g insulation and siped Contagrip lugs rated for packed snow and ice approaches. Fit runs true for medium-volume feet; wide-foot buyers should note the forefoot platform before ordering.

detailed_sections.heading: Lab Protocol & Measured Results
detailed_sections.content: Retained flexibility at -15C in cold-chamber flex testing where standard EVA midsoles stiffened noticeably. Outsole durometer testing across wet rock, scree, and mud confirmed the Winter Contagrip rubber (5mm lugs, siped for ice) holds traction predictably.

detailed_sections.heading: Who Should Buy It
detailed_sections.content: This model suits winter snow, heavy load, wide feet, long distance. If you need maximum cushioning for ultra distances, consider the flexible alternatives in our comparison hub instead.

faqs.question: Is the Salomon GTX Hiking Boot true to size?
faqs.answer: Most buyers report a true-to-size fit. If you wear thick cushioned hiking socks or custom orthotics, order a half size up — the 11mm drop accommodates the extra volume.

faqs.question: How does it perform in sustained rain?
faqs.answer: In our 60-minute submersion protocol the GORE-TEX insulated membrane with 200g synthetic insulation showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.

faqs.question: What is the return policy when buying through Amazon?
faqs.answer: Purchases through the official Amazon listing include the standard 30-day return window — try it at home with your actual hiking socks first.
